evals.name: add-copies
evals.expected_output: Book copies available with no loans yet.
assertions: Defines public static Reduce on BookAvailability.
Takes BookAdded @event then nullable previous BookAvailability.
Returns the event's number of copies and zero on loan.

evals.name: count-loans
evals.prompt: Track one more BookBorrowed without exceeding the number of copies.
assertions: Adds one to the previous loan count.
Returns a new value instead of mutating the earlier instance.

evals.name: borrow-before-add
evals.prompt: Test borrowing before the book is added and after two copies have been added.
evals.expected_output: Checks for missing state and successive loan counts.
assertions: Checks that a borrow on missing state returns null.
Feeds the first loan result to the second reduction.
Checks two loans for two copies even after a third borrow event.
